title: Jewelry is at the bottom of the muddy sea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Seeking the Pearl versus Taiki Shuttle.
Under heavy downpour,
the matchup
between these two up-and-coming
generational talents
is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this race one for the books,
Taiki! Now, catch me if you c—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm? This sensation at my feet... What is
this? It feels... mushy?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, how am I supposed to run my
best like this?! Talk about a
drag!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll be going ahead! Catch ya at the finish
line!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Taiki?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl slowly sinks into the
back of the pack. Forget
competing with
Taiki Shuttle, she couldn't even beat the
other
Umamusume in the race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! How could this... How could
I lose that easily?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nice racin' out there, Pearl. Let me guess...
you ain't a fan of muddy
tracks?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Muddy tracks..." Haha, I suppose not. It's
true they aren't my forte,
but that wasn't
the problem.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's a much bigger reason why I
couldn't run well today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh? And that reason is?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I simply wasn't feeling it today! I lost
because I didn't put my heart
into it, not
because of the track condition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It seems my passion saw the
muddy track and said, "No
thank you!"

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Really, now? Seeking the Pearl is laughing after losing that badly?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so it was a problem with her mood, not
the track. And if that's the
case... then it
might be a deal-breaker.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I mean results like today's could happen
anytime, regardless of the
track's
condition. If anything goes awry, then
she's unable to show off
her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's difficult to work with.
And from what she just
said, she's
probably temperamental, to boot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Difficult to work with." Her potential is
the real deal, but whether or
not she'll
realize that potential all comes down to
her mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Plus, besides poor track conditions, if any
minor issue can really throw
off her whole
game...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now for what everyone's been waiting
for—scouting time! At long
last, I'm ready
to accept your bouquets!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tell me your dreams, and I may just take
your offer! Come on! Hey,
come ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Waaaaait! Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wai—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is swarmed with scouting
offers. In stark contrast, not a
single
trainer stands in front of Seeking the
Pearl's open arms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that night, I find myself walking
around campus deep in
thought. It's not
every day you see such a hyped-up
Umamusume get
zero scouting offers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Difficult to work with." "Temperamental."
If she really is that finicky,
then I might
understand the other trainers' reluctance,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, I stumble across a lone
Seeking the Pearl. I wonder
what she's up
to?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Right. The fact is, my heart wasn't in
today's race. My annoyance
with the mud
drowned out my desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I was just spinning my wheels with no
destination in mind. Yes, that
must've
been what happened.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And what about the distance? 1,600
meters... It's well within my skill
set. That
said, my talents aren't for me to decide by
myself.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This world is so vast. Even if I'm good at
something, there's always
another
Umamusume who's even better. Like
Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My brilliance as a gemstone... isn't
something that I decide alone. But
how am
I going to find my path with all these
sparkling jewels
blocking my sight?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I can't outshine them right now, I'll just
have to find another path.
Or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes an expression I never would've
imagined the haughty
Umamusume from
this afternoon could pull—one of
reflection and
contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her pensive expression, you
wouldn't think that she hasn't
even
debuted yet. It's like I'm staring at the
goddess of wisdom...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Difficult to work with." I think back to
those words. But if she really is
a
self-centered and moody Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then why is she making a face like that?
